ValidationRule.description: Make Primary Product Line & Billing Country mandatory of opp fields when Deal Review is created.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISNEW(), OR( ISBLANK( TEXT(Opportunity__r.Primary_Product_Line__c)), ISBLANK( Opportunity__r.Billing_Country__c ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Deal Review requires Billing Country and Primary Product Line. Please update these Opportunity fields
